title: Files
description: A worker's checkout as a tree in its tabs, what git sees changed marked, and a file opened beside it, drawn by the view its type picks: code highlighted as VS Code draws it, the rest by the tower's views by type.

repos/<project>/<id>.description: The repos of the worker's checkout, each named as a review anchor names it.

tree/<project>/<id>.description: One folder of a repo of the worker's checkout: folders first, each in name order, what git ignores marked; .git never listed.

path.description: The folder, relative to the repo: its top when left out.

kind.description: A link is the kind it points at.

more.description: How many entries past the first 2000 are not listed.

status/<project>/<id>.description: What git sees changed in each repo of the worker's checkout, a mark by path (M, A, D, R, U untracked, C in conflict; an untracked folder as its path and a slash), and a stamp that changes when any of it does.

stat/<project>/<id>.description: One file of the worker's checkout: its size, when it last changed, its media type (a file of an unknown kind with no NUL in its first 8 KB is text/plain), and its absolute path, for the editor and Finder.

raw/<project>/<id>/<repo>/<file...>.description: One file of the worker's checkout, as written, sandboxed: up to 50 MB.
